subject: Request: bundle startup cohort credits with dedicated discount
messages:
From: Maria Valdez <maria@nebulalabs.ai>
To: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@nebula.ai>
Cc: procurement@nebulalabs.ai
Date: 2026-09-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cohort credits + Dedicated discount — feasibility question

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Quick question from our program team: Nebula is onboarding 12 startups into our Fall cohort and we'd like to combine the Redwood "cohort credits" promo you offered with a short-term Dedicated discount while they ramp. Specifically: can the $40k cohort credit be applied against a customer-managed Dedicated reservation, or does it only apply to Hosted usage? If not directly applicable, is there a standard way you handle this (invoice credit, escrowed consumption, or an exception)?

Procurement will need to understand contract and billing implications — term, invoicing cadence, and whether credits can be used to offset committed monthly spend. I attached a draft SOW for context (Nebula_SOW_v1.pdf).

Looking for a clear path so we can finalize procurement by next Friday.

Best,
Maria
Program Director | Nebula Labs
Attachments: Nebula_SOW_v1.pdf
From: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Maria Valdez <maria@nebulalabs.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@nebula.ai>, procurement@nebulalabs.ai
Date: 2026-09-23T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort credits + Dedicated discount — feasibility question

Hi Maria — thanks for the SOW, and congrats on the cohort lineup. Looping in Ben (sales) and Lauren (finance) to weigh in on billing mechanics, and Marissa from CS for onboarding cadence.

Short answer: credits and Dedicated discounts are normally distinct buckets — credits apply to Hosted API consumption, while Dedicated reservations are billed against committed capacity. That said, there are three practical approaches we can offer depending on what Nebula needs:

- Option A (Preferred): Apply cohort credits to hosted consumption for the cohort's onboarding/testing phase, and then transition startups to a short-term Dedicated reservation with an introductory discount. This keeps accounting clean and avoids contract rework.
- Option B (Invoice Credit): We apply the $40k as an invoice credit against the Dedicated reservation invoices for the first X months. Requires accounting approval and explicit contract language.
- Option C (Hybrid/Top-up): Keep credits on Hosted, but provide a top-up/dedicated discount coupon that reduces your committed rate for the first 3 months. Simpler operationally but limited term.

I've attached a preliminary pricing matrix with the above sketched out (pricing_matrix.xlsx). Ben — can you propose discount thresholds and the approval path? Lauren — any cautions from revenue recognition / accounting? Marissa — estimate lead time for onboarding 12 teams if we split hosted trial then move them to Dedicated.

If helpful, we can join a 30-min call tomorrow to finalize approach so procurement can have clear language by Friday.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing_matrix.xlsx
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Maria Valdez <maria@nebulalabs.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-23T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort credits + Dedicated discount — feasibility question

Maria / Alex — jumping in. Thanks Alex for the options. A few practical guardrails from GTM:

- We can offer a one-time promotional Dedicated discount (example: 30% off committed unit rate) for up to 3 months if Nebula signs a minimum 6-month reserved commitment across the cohort pool. This is a sales-approved promo but requires Revenue ops sign-off.
- Cohort credits cannot be converted to cash; however, for enterprise partners we sometimes run an "invoice credit" carve-out: credits stay allocated to the program but we apply an equivalent dollar credit to the invoice for the Reserved capacity. This must be spelled out in the SOW and is limited to the cohort (non-transferable).
- If Procurement requires the credits to reduce committed obligation directly, Legal needs the SOW to include an explicit credit-application clause and our Billing team needs the DocuSign path to flag the special handling.

If Nebula prefers Option B (invoice credit), I'll need Lauren's sign-off on the recognition and Marissa to confirm there won't be onboarding bottlenecks impacting the credit schedule. Proposed next step: Alex/Ben to send a clean SOW with the chosen option and I'll prep an internal approval request.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Maria Valdez <maria@nebulalabs.ai>, procurement@nebulalabs.ai
Date: 2026-09-24T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort credits + Dedicated discount — feasibility question

Thanks — quick accounting note from our side so procurement knows what to expect:

- Revenue treatment differs by approach. Option A (credits applied to Hosted first) is simplest: Hosted consumption is offset by the promo credit at time of usage, no revenue deferral complexity for Dedicated.
- Option B (invoice credit applied to Dedicated invoices) is doable but requires two things: (1) explicit SOW language that binds the $40k to Nebula's Dedicated invoices and (2) a billing memo to our AR team so they record a contra-revenue/invoice credit rather than treating it as an early payment. This may push recognition timing and requires the customer to accept the special term in the contract.

Operational asks for procurement: please confirm whether Nebula requires the credit to reduce the committed obligation itself or if an invoice-level credit is acceptable. If invoice credit is fine, our Billing + Legal teams can prepare the DocuSign amendment once we have the final SOW. I've added a suggested clause below that you can paste into the SOW: 

"Company Promo Credit: Redwood will apply a one-time credit of $40,000 (the \"Cohort Credit\") to Nebula Labs' invoices. The Cohort Credit is non-transferable and will be applied to invoices generated for Reserved Dedicated Capacity within the first 90 days following contract signature. Any unused portion after 90 days will expire."

I'll also note: for AR to suppress cash collection while crediting invoices we need the signed DocuSign before the first invoice posts.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
From: Maria Valdez <maria@nebulalabs.ai>

Subject: Re: Cohort credits + Dedicated discount — feasibility question

- Legal asks that the SOW include the exact credit clause Lauren suggested.
- Timeline: target signing by next Thursday so cohort onboarding can start the first week of October.

Please send the updated SOW with the clause and DocuSign link. I re-attached the draft SOW for reference.

Best,
